eval_dimensions.name: One C4 Level, Chosen From the Question
eval_dimensions.description: The diagram uses exactly one C4 include, picked from what the request asks (context / container / component / dynamic / deployment); a request spanning levels yields one file per level.

eval_dimensions.name: Elements and Relationships Carry Their Meaning
eval_dimensions.description: Every Container/Component has a technology argument, every data store (including files) is a ContainerDb, every Rel has a verb-phrase label, and SHOW_LEGEND() closes the diagram.

eval_dimensions.name: Rendered Through render.sh and Inspected
eval_dimensions.description: scripts/render.sh exits 0 on the final source and the agent Reads the PNG before hand-back, catching swallowed labels such as a bare ~.

eval_dimensions.name: Existing Structurizr Model Is Not Duplicated
eval_dimensions.description: When the repo already has a workspace.dsl, the agent edits that model instead of drawing a second, hand-made C4 picture.

evals.name: Container view names technologies, stores, and labeled edges
evals.description: RED baseline: without the skill the agent guessed macros, omitted the legend, and never looked at the PNG. With the skill every element is typed and the image is read.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-c4 "container diagram of the Dev10x plugin: skills, hooks, an MCP server calling GitHub, state in ~/.config/Dev10x"

assertions.signal: single_container_include — the source has exactly one include line, '!include <C4/C4_Container>'
store_is_containerdb — the ~/.config/Dev10x store is a ContainerDb with a technology argument, and the source ends with SHOW_LEGEND()
png_inspected — the PNG printed by skills/diagram-c4/scripts/render.sh is Read before completion

evals.name: Repo with workspace.dsl gets a model edit, not a new .puml
evals.description: In a repo whose root holds workspace.dsl, a request for a container view edits the Structurizr model.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-c4 "add the new billing service to our container diagram" — repo root contains workspace.dsl

assertions.signal: model_detected — a Glob for workspace.dsl runs before any .puml is written
no_parallel_puml — no new C4 .puml file is created; the change lands in a .dsl file

evals.name: Context plus component request yields two files
evals.description: A request for both the big picture and the inside of one service produces a context diagram and a component diagram, not one mixed picture.
evals.input: /dev10x:diagram-c4 "show how the platform fits together and what's inside the payments service"

assertions.signal: one_level_per_file — two .puml files are written, one including C4_Context and one including C4_Component

should_trigger: Draw a C4 container diagram of the platform
Show what talks to what in our system for the ADR
Diagram where the services are deployed
should_not_trigger: Draw the login request flow step by step
Model the refund approval process with lanes
